ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the southern part of Jiangsu Province in the figure, the symbols for cities and towns are relatively concentrated, transportation lines such as railways, major roads, and waterways are also denser, and there are more transportation nodes; in contrast, the distribution of city points and transportation lines in the Subei region is relatively sparse. method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中江苏南部城市点、铁路和主要公路线较密集，港口或交通节点也较多；苏北地区城市和交通线相对稀疏。再读题干：问题要求比较苏南与苏北的城市化速度。根据城市和交通基础设施密度越高、经济活动越集中，城市化推进越快的地理判断规则，推出苏南地区城市化速度比苏北快。
